title: On the Tightness and Computational Tractability of Higher-Dimensional Confidence Sequences

split.decision: No cross-instance fitting. Public validation: paper A/B seeds 1,2; replication seeds 101..120 and 201..220; original Figure 4 streams. Evaluation uses independently secret-generated streams of the same distributions; scenario and role are labels only. Observations materialized offline, opaque shuffled IDs. Preserve 500-batch horizon and 20 coverage checkpoints. The paper pair is replaced only on hidden evaluation to prevent seed reconstruction.

baseline.paper_ref: Table 3: reproduced mean 267.0 batches; original fixed pair, alpha=.05, r_tol=.02.

allowed_changes: Confidence-sequence construction, predictable betting strategy where used, within the fixed c, theta and weights, and geometric approximation.
Numerical algorithms, internal representations and implementation, provided the returned set and decisions refer to the original mean coordinates and preserve statistical validity.
Legal configuration selection from public development data, subject to the existing no-memorization and per-stream information rules.
fixed_contract: Minimize the first valid A/B stopping time for the supplied bounded multivariate mean problem, subject to the original significance, uncertainty-volume, coverage and false-flag requirements.
The supplied ten-coordinate A/B web-metric observations and their original population-mean coordinates; the five-dimensional coverage problems and their observation models.
Original observation streams/splits, per-stream independence, and permitted observation prefixes.
Alpha 0.05, significance threshold 0.5, volume-radius tolerance 0.02, horizon 500, and the original ordering of stopping decisions.
Original 20-checkpoint joint-coverage and replicate false-flag checks, mean-stop metric and Monte Carlo volume protocol.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: The truncation constant c=3/4, hedge theta=1/2 and uniform portfolio weights are fixed, because the experiment compares constructions at the same stake settings.

The set must be valid at alpha=0.05 for every stream bounded in [0,1]^D: do not assume a narrower support or a known variance taken from the simulator or validation, and do not lower the evidence threshold to use the slack in the coverage floor or false-flag cap.
At a volume-decided stop at least 100 of the 125,000 Monte Carlo points must fall inside the set, otherwise the prediction is invalid (scorer).
Replace the specified mean coordinates with a different embedding or an easier estimand, or score a transformed target without mapping back to the original scientific coordinates.
Change supplied observations, stream distribution, stopping thresholds, uncertainty measure, coverage aggregation or volume sampling rule.
Use a separate optimistic coverage construction unrelated to the A/B method, future observations, private scenario identity or memorized distribution truths.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
